data: Fictional, memory-only records. External traffic blocked.

screenshots.title: Your Android home
screenshots.caption: See assigned areas and start a work request.

screenshots.title: Personal Android access
screenshots.caption: Review Panchayats and Villages already saved in My Areas, then continue to your personal Android login code. This narrow desktop preview uses fictional records.

screenshots.title: Secretary access
screenshots.caption: Assign a Panchayat or Village and create a Secretary login code.

screenshots.title: First setup and your login page
screenshots.caption: One guided page at a time: Login area, Sign in, Work areas and Download records. All app menus remain available before portal sign-in and during setup. Saved settings and records stay through updates. This narrow desktop preview uses fictional choices; the official website is not pictured.

screenshots.title: Review a phone request
screenshots.caption: Review workers and their requested days, then use Send to office. This sends a phone request for DEO review; it does not create an official portal demand.

screenshots.title: Secretary request history
screenshots.caption: Find requests and follow the status returned by the office.

screenshots.title: Job Card households
screenshots.caption: Find household heads and open the members of a Job Card. Swipe the table for more columns.

screenshots.title: Choose workers and days
screenshots.caption: Choose workers and days. Check portal reads their public reports on the phone. Open a worker's information button for answers, sources and check times.

screenshots.title: Worker filters
screenshots.caption: Keep the list compact with saved status and identity check choices.

screenshots.title: Guided Work Demand
screenshots.caption: Follow the Work Demand steps. Show or hide Worked and Days left separately with saved switches. These figures are information only; your entered days stay unchanged.

screenshots.title: Check demand issues
screenshots.caption: See the worker and the required check needing attention. eKYC and ABPS remain required; optional seeding and day figures do not block a demand.

screenshots.title: Record download progress
screenshots.caption: Follow the measured record download percentage on a received request. Saved checks set the percentage; record download progress does not mean a demand was submitted.

screenshots.title: Muster Roll Reports
screenshots.caption: Choose Panchayats and Villages for the official attendance reports.

screenshots.title: Simple app settings
screenshots.caption: Choose a Settings section, then change the options you need. Work, App and Account choices stay together. This is a narrow desktop preview.

screenshots.title: Your Android account
screenshots.caption: Check your role and assigned area, or sign out. Android follows the phone system colours.
